zones.title: 1. Shipping Agent
zones.body: Called with the sender email, the customer name and the delivery address as written. Tools: find the Sold-To by email, list its Ship-To partner roles, read the plant cut-off (OCB). Structured output only; codes must come from a tool result.

zones.title: 2. Deterministic verify and log
zones.body: The chosen Ship-To must be a partner of the chosen Sold-To, re-read from the table. The cut-off is evaluated in the plant's time zone and the earliest dispatch date computed. Tool calls go to step_log.
